BEHIND THE NOTEBOOK

Hello, I’m J.amy.

That's a pen name. And this is an open notebook where I explore whatever is happening right now. A scrapbook of life snippets without the ticket stubs to prove any of it actually happened. If anything here makes any sense or has any recognizable form, it's completely unintentional.
